\begin{bankq}[id=SA01-P1-MATH-S1-Q01, source={Score Advanced - Test 01 (22 Sep 2020)}, paper=1, qno=1, type=single, subtopic={Planes}, answer={C}, answer_src=key, difficulty=7, diff_parts={K2 S2 I2 C2 F0}, diff_note={concepts: locus of the foot of a perpendicular, planes | steps: intercepts from the roots; plane equation; foot; locus}]

\opt{B}{$(x^2+y^2+z^2)^4\left(\dfrac1{xy}+\dfrac1{yz}+\dfrac1{zx}\right)=5$}
\opt{C}{$(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2\left(\dfrac1{xy}+\dfrac1{yz}+\dfrac1{zx}\right)=5$}
\opt{D}{$(x^2+y^2+z^2)(xy+yz+zx)=5$}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}
